query: Marvell Technology custom AI silicon data center revenue Q2 fiscal 2026
normalized: 2026 ai center custom data fiscal marvell q2 revenue silicon technology

output.content:
Marvell did **not separately disclose custom AI silicon revenue** for Q2 fiscal 2026 (quarter ended August 2, 2025). It reported **data-center revenue of $1.490 billion**, up **3% sequentially** and **69% year over year**, with performance led by custom XPU/XPU-attach products and electro-optics interconnects. [[1]] 

Management said that **custom silicon plus electro-optics collectively represented more than 75%** of data-center revenue; accordingly, their combined revenue was **more than approximately $1.12 billion** ($1.490 billion × 75%), but the company did not provide a standalone custom-silicon amount. [[1]] 

For context, total Marvell Q2 FY2026 revenue was **$2.006 billion**, so data center represented **74%** of company revenue. [[2, 3]]
